text:
If you’ve been waiting for a real fall day to get outside, today’s the one: full sunshine, a high right around 62, and a light south wind. It’s a chilly 37 to start, but temperatures will climb nicely through the morning, with dry air and good visibility all day. On the lake, south winds run 15 to 20 knots before easing, with waves building as high as 4 feet, so smaller boats should pick their window carefully. Tonight stays clear with a low near 42.

Tuesday keeps the sunshine but turns cooler, topping out around 56 as a north wind picks up. The lake gets choppier again, with north winds increasing to 15 to 20 knots and waves up to 3 feet. Take the long walk or bike ride today, and if you’re heading onto the water, aim for the calmer morning before the afternoon wind fills in.
